segments.name: Targeted radiotherapies
segments.description: Clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing targeted radiotherapies for patients with solid tumors and hematologic malignancies.
segments.evidence: We operate as a single operating segment focused on research, discovery, and clinical development of targeted radiotherapies.

revenueModel.text: The company records no commercial revenue; it earns grant revenue and is eligible for milestone payments and royalties from licensees such as Immedica.
revenueModel.evidence: We are eligible to receive certain regulatory and commercial milestone payments and royalties on net sales of the product in certain countries that may result from the License Agreement.
